===='''Brandon's Wheel of Time Reread on Twitter - 3 January 2011'''====

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22003950412636160 Brandon on Twitter - 3 January 2011]
Happy New Year, all. It is official--I have begun working on A Memory of Light, 14th and final book of the Wheel of Time.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22004713016786944 Brandon]
I have updated the progress bars on my website with this year's tasks. I'll try to be better about keeping them current.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22011643806351360 Brandon]
The first step is to re-read the entire Wheel of Time. TofM had some small continuity errors--mostly me forgetting who knows what.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22011799251451905 Brandon]
We fixed them for the paperback, but it is a sign that I'm starting to forget details. That means I need to re-read Mr. Jordan's work.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22016101227433984 Brandon]
By the way, I did get a Nook for my birthday. So I'm in the process of getting e-copies of the WoT uploaded.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22017227377090560 Brandon]
Since people are asking, the continuity errors were things like Grady telling Perrin about the Cleansing as if for the first time, but...

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22017426426171392 Brandon]
...there's a line in KoD where Perrin notes that they'd mentioned it to him. We don't see the conversation, but it's there in narrative.

[http://twitter.com/AJZaethe/status/22016877073010688 AJ Zaethe]
Need a devout reader of the Wheel of Time to watch over what you are writing so they can be like. "He died in book 5." "oh"

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22017696031838208 Brandon]
The thing is, I had eight of those for TofM. They all missed these too. It was the time crunch that did it to us, I think.

[http://twitter.com/bepeacock/status/22016233062797313 Benjamin Peacock]
No biggie, but did you fix for ebook by chance?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22017759000920064 Brandon]
Yes, it should be all fixed for the ebook.

[http://twitter.com/C3Zinger/status/22024051199315968 Michelle Anders]
Also the fact that Min's viewings aren't always around Aes Sedai when they are supposed to be.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22025516924014592 Brandon]
I'm working on the assumption (as she's said before) that she doesn't always pay attention to them, as there's so many of them.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22021924657831936 Brandon]
Yes, I will be live tweeting/blogging my re-read. Should have some fun things to post about the WoT as I go.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22025838736179200 Brandon]
Some are asking if my tweets/blogs will have spoilers for WoT books. I'll try to keep those to a minimum. But there will be some.

[http://twitter.com/Theoryland/status/22040266126921730 Matt Hatch]
Have you considered using a hashtag for your WoT re-read tweets? Would make it easier for fans to follow and participate.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22041162151895040 Brandon]
Yeah, but I always forget to put in the hashtags...

[http://twitter.com/Theoryland/status/22042254520623104 Matt Hatch]
Pick a hashtag. We can always retweet the stuff you forget to tag. That's what HCFFs are for, right?

[http://twitter.com/Theoryland/status/22058845748592640 Matt Hatch]
Want to join in the re-read fun? @[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson BrandonSandrson] is tweeting as he goes. Use this hashtag [http://twitter.com/search?q=%23wotrr #wotrr] to follow and comment as it progresses.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22028786652422144 Brandon]
Man, I love the EotW prologue. Some of my favorite writing in the entire series. Great insight into Ishamael's personality pre-madness.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22029268426956800 Brandon]
People like to talk of Rand's character development. Elan -> Ishamael -> Moridin is almost as interesting to me. His outlook has evolved so much.

[http://twitter.com/evanchooly/status/22036469870759936 Justin Lee]
Has it really evolved? he's still the megalomanical favorite/topdog he's always seen himself to be.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040987345883136 Brandon]
No, he's really changed a lot. He's a fatalist now, as I mentioned to @[http://twitter.com/dragonmount dragonmount]. He knows far more.

[http://twitter.com/dragonmount/status/22037696142639104 Jason Denzel]
How would you compare Ishamael's motivations from when he was Elan vs when he was Moridin?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040423891476480 Brandon]
Elan is actually more selfish. He still thinks he will rule, that the Dark One will take over the world and create a new one.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040602807894017 Brandon]
Moridin has been through madness and touched the mind of the Dark One. He is far more fatalistic, and actually less selfish.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/22128869569994753 Terez]
And therefore...less predictable? :)

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22141314476810240 Brandon]
I was wondering if anyone would pick up on that quote<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=dcjspjqg_1001hng4gxff&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-1 1]</sup> in relation to my tweet.

[http://twitter.com/Southpaw2014/status/22087662022168576 Austin Moore]
Is it wrong for me to have been under the impression that Moridin isn't "mad?" I've thought he was less mad than he was...

[http://twitter.com/Southpaw2014/status/22087771598360577 Austin Moore]
...as Ishamael. Mad being crazy not mad being evil because obviously he's evil.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22126974826717184 Brandon]
Moridin is less insane than Ishamael was. Much as Rand is less insane than Lews Therin was.

[http://twitter.com/Azral_Joe/status/22233473087442944 Azral Joe]
You say Moridin is less selfish. Is he now a Dark Buddha wanting to end the suffering of existence in the nirvana of oblivion?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22396403380654081 Brandon]
It's not that he's unselfish. But compare his lines in EotW and KoD or TofM to see the difference.

[http://twitter.com/DoctorD71/status/22039570409324546 Derek Daniels]
Never did figure out what it is exactly that killed Lews Therin in the prologue. Thoughts after reread?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040142504001536 Brandon]
It's a toss up between getting consumed by holding too much Power and getting struck by that bolt of energy from the sky.

[http://twitter.com/amysuefarmer/status/22045581400612864 Amy Farmer]
Out of curiosity, why aren't you starting with New Spring? Useful continuity stuff there.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22046859828662272 Brandon]
I like reading New Spring when it was released. Feels better to me there.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22036178098196480 Brandon]
The first wind is in the Mountains of Mist; I've always assumed this was a nod to Tolkien's Misty Mountains.<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=dcjspjqg_1001hng4gxff&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-2 2]</sup>

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22036356624551936 Brandon]
Look in The Way of Kings on the full map of Roshar for something similar.<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=dcjspjqg_1001hng4gxff&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-3 3]</sup>

[http://twitter.com/SheckyX/status/22036609230700544 Shecky X]
Well, his Charlestonian background makes the "Two Rivers" the Charleston area, so the "Mountains of Mist" may be...

[http://twitter.com/SheckyX/status/22036798351867904 Shecky X]
... the Smoky Mountains, upstate from his home. (FYI: the Charleston area is defined by the Ashley and Cooper Rivers.)

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040753224024064 Brandon]
Nice note. I'd never known that.

[http://twitter.com/lynnoliverfhmg/status/22041360278228992 Lynn Oliver]
Listening to WoT on audiobook, first time through series. Book 1 seems heavily influenced by Tolkien so far.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22045530888601600 Brandon]
Yes, book one is very Tolkien influenced. Very. Book two less so. It's almost gone by book three.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22039689976348672 Brandon]
Reading this book, I'm reminded of how deeply Dragonsteel (one of my foundational, yet, unpublished works) was influenced by the WoT's start.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22040034286764034 Brandon]
Actually, of the three fantasy epics I wrote during my early years--Dragonsteel, Elantris, & White Sand--Elantris was the least WoT-like.

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/22041755809484800 Terez]
Elantris in a way reminded me of King's ''Eyes of the Dragon'', with the fairy-tale-like writing style.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22045752607899648 Brandon]
I love Eyes of the Dragon. Might be an unconscious influence.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22044325193981952 Brandon]
Reading the start of EOTW reminds me that there's an extra person in the cover art. (More obvious in the secondary, inside piece, I think.)

[http://twitter.com/neonorange00/status/22106375278559233 neonorange00]
In the EotW cover there's only Moraine, Lan, and one boy to the side. Am I looking at the wrong one?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22130124103090176 Brandon]
There are two covers. One ended up on the inside flaps. The outer one wraps around, though, and I think he's in both.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22130160920694786 Brandon]
Here's the secondary cover: http://bit.ly/hZu0Uw

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22045173202558976 Brandon]
HCFFs already know who that person is, but it's a fun easter egg to know that there's a story behind that extra figure.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22047050354925568 Brandon]
Mr. Jordan wrote a large chunk of EotW with a fourth Two Rivers lad going along with Perrin, Mat, and Rand. Was to be a major character.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22047626132197376 Brandon]
Harriet talked him out of it, pointing out that the 4th lad never did anything useful. @[http://twitter.com/theoryland theoryland], do you guys have a good thread on him?

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/22055137044336640 Terez]
Nah, nothing to talk about really. But here is RJ saying that: http://bit.ly/RJ-BN2000

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22055914840260608 Brandon]
I've asked Harriet if she could dig up any of the old manuscript with the Fourth ''ta'veren'' in it, but she's not certain they have any.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22056380286369792 Brandon]
She said she thinks he was Dannil, but couldn't remember for certain. Many think he was Ewin--a good guess and a possibility.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22057457454948352 Brandon]
Cover art was commissioned when he was still a main character, and it was too late to change it when he was removed.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22061585581219840 Brandon]
Looks like the Fourth ''ta'veren'' was Dannil, in another form: http://bit.ly/h0iDIO (Look for Liandra's question.)<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=dcjspjqg_1001hng4gxff&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-4 4]</sup>

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22082891282391040 Brandon]
Jason from @[http://twitter.com/dragonmount dragonmount] says: "RJ once told me that Daniell's heroics ended up being done by the other Two Rivers boys."

[http://twitter.com/Azral_Joe/status/22219220620148736 Azral Joe]
What role would the so-called 'Fourth' ta'veren have played if he had been wrritten into the story? Could you elaborate?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22396210211983360 Brandon]
I'd like to see the original drafts if I could. I do know RJ said his part was split among the other three.

[http://twitter.com/neonorange00/status/22687171823534080 neonorange]
Is the fourth boy (Dannil)'s name pronounced [dan-nil] or [daniel]?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22745176569024512 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22049996874448896 Brandon]
By the way, HCFF stands for "Hard Core Fan Freak" for those asking. They're self named. It's what many uber-wot-geeks call themselves.<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=dcjspjqg_1001hng4gxff&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-5 5]</sup>

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22051399936245760 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/skylatron/status/22051758649901057 Skyla Grimes]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22053046510952449 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22060696095162368 Brandon]
For those asking, I'm not allowed to talk about the prequels yet. It's unlikely they'll be written. If they aren't, I'll see what I can say.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22055334558310400 Brandon]
